Name: Bundles Open Sooner
Author: ncarigon
Description:
This mod includes a simple code patch to do one thing:

[list]
[*]Open all Community Center bundles after the first bundle is completed.
[/list]
This makes all Community Center bundles act how the Pantry and Fish Tank bundles do in the base game. This is primarily beneficial when using mods that randomize bundle content, removing the need to wait a significant time to see what items need to be submitted.

This mod should be compatible with any mods that alter bundles, but mods that add new Community Center rooms may not open any sooner. None were tested.

Source: [url=https://github.com/ncarigon/StardewValleyMods]ncarigon/StardewValleyMods (github.com)[/url]
